detailed_descriptions.en: We remain committed to making your experience the best we can, and thank you for your support. Embrace the storm with Discharge, an electrifying machete salvaged from the heart of Harran. Designed as a tool of destruction, its charged blade crackles with untamed energy, cleaving through the Infected with a visceral thrill. DLC contains: - Discharge Machete - VNC Weapon Charm

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
We remain committed to making your experience the best we can, and thank you for your support.

Embrace the storm with Discharge, an electrifying machete salvaged from the heart of Harran. Designed as a tool of destruction, its charged blade crackles with untamed energy, cleaving through the Infected with a visceral thrill.

DLC contains:

- Discharge Machete

- VNC Weapon Charm
